### Technical Workshops

To support further progress in the implementation of the IOTC Regional Observer Scheme (ROS), the Secretariat organised three capacity-building workshops in 2026, focusing on data collection and reporting requirements for purse seine, longline and gillnet fisheries. These workshops aimed to strengthen CPCs' understanding of reporting requirements, promote the use of standardised reporting forms and improve the quality and completeness of observer data.

Summaries of the workshops are provided in Appendix I, with further details in Appendix III. Reports of the purse seine and longline workshops are available on their respective meeting webpages, while the report of the gillnet workshop is under preparation.

## Participation in External Meetings and Workshops

The Data Section participated in technical exchanges concerning EU data reporting and coordination, the Indian Ocean shark research plan, bycatch data, and abandoned, lost or otherwise discarded fishing gear (ALDFG), among other subjects. These activities supported dialogue on data requirements, harmonisation and data quality.
